description: Address GitHub issue #315. Preserve tagged thaw results at the InstanceManager start boundary; start fresh only when storage is disabled or the checkpoint is absent; return structured thaw errors without registering a child; add regression coverage for corrupt checkpoints with an ahead-of-zero journal and verify durable data remains unchanged.

comments.text: Implemented explicit fresh/restored thaw start modes and fail-closed error propagation as {:error, {:thaw_failed, reason}}. Added corrupt file-checkpoint regression with rev-2 journal invariants plus generic non-not-found error coverage. Validation: mix test test/jido/agent/instance_manager_test.exs (33 passed); mix q passed; mix test passed.
Draft PR opened: https://github.com/agentjido/jido/pull/316. Commit d1d02a4; branch jido-7mc/fail-closed-thaw.
Review hardening: remove redundant Keyed lifecycle thaw (InstanceManager is its only caller and already preflights storage), add a single-read regression, and simplify the explicit thaw result gate.

Review result: retained Keyed lifecycle restore because it is required for DynamicSupervisor crash-restart recovery (durable cron tests fail without it). Simplified InstanceManager to one tagged {:ok, agent_or_nil} gate plus a dedicated child-start helper and documented the private result contract. Revalidation: targeted 33 passed, mix q passed, full mix test passed.
Amended review commit 58cec7f and force-pushed PR #316.

Landing verification found CI matrix failures in scheduler durability integration: the test still expected a fresh agent from a corrupt checkpoint. Updated it to assert {:thaw_failed, ...}, no registry child, and unchanged checkpoint; split the live-agent cancel preservation case. Validation: scheduler integration 8 passed; mix q passed; mix test passed.

title: Fail closed on InstanceManager thaw errors
